title: "uv-python display and last-expression parity"
engine: uv-python
format: html

  output: true
---

This fixture exercises the no-Jupyter `uv_python_runtime` display API and narrow
Jupyter-like last top-level expression display.

```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import uv_python_runtime
from uv_python_runtime import display, Markdown, HTML, Text

runtime_file = Path(uv_python_runtime.__file__).as_posix()
display(Text(f"RUNTIME_IMPORT_ENGINE_PACKAGE {runtime_file.endswith('_extensions/uv-python/uv_python_runtime/__init__.py')}"))
display(Text("TEXT_WRAPPER_LITERAL **not markdown**"))
display(Markdown("**DISPLAY_MARKDOWN_WRAPPER**"))
display(HTML('<span id="display-html-wrapper"><strong>DISPLAY_HTML_WRAPPER</strong></span>'))
```

```{python}
class ReprMarkdownObject:
    def _repr_markdown_(self):
        return "**REPR_MARKDOWN_OBJECT**"


class ToMarkdownObject:
    def to_markdown(self):
        return "*TO_MARKDOWN_OBJECT*"


class ReprHtmlObject:
    def _repr_html_(self):
        return '<span id="repr-html-object">REPR_HTML_OBJECT</span>'


class ToHtmlObject:
    def to_html(self):
        return '<span id="to-html-object">TO_HTML_OBJECT</span>'


class ReprFallbackObject:
    def __repr__(self):
        return "REPR_FALLBACK_OBJECT **not markdown**"


display(ReprMarkdownObject())
display(ToMarkdownObject())
display(ReprHtmlObject())
display(ToHtmlObject())
display(ReprFallbackObject())
```
